# RootRecord Solana Tools
# Machine-readable site summary for LLM / AI crawlers (see also: https://solana.rootrecord.info/operations/reference)

## Site
- Public URL: https://solana.rootrecord.info
- Marketing / accounts hub: https://rootrecord.info
- Product type: Web-based Solana utilities (wallet-connected; self-custody)

## What this product does
RootRecord Solana Tools lets users connect a Solana wallet (e.g. Phantom-class adapters) and:
- Create SPL tokens and Token-2022 mints with optional Metaplex-compatible metadata and Pinata IPFS pinning (`/create`).
- Manage tokens on-chain: revoke mint or freeze authority, bulk freeze/thaw holder token accounts, mint more supply, burn balances, update or lock Metaplex listing metadata (legacy SPL), Token-2022 withheld-fee withdraw/harvest and fee-config updates (`/tools`).
- Create or adjust Raydium CPMM liquidity (pool creation, add/remove liquidity) (`/liquidity`).
- Send native SOL or SPL tokens to many recipients in batched transactions (`/bulk`).
- Generate a printable cold-storage paper wallet in the browser (`/wallet-generator`).
- Look up shareable token stats for a mint (`/token-stats`, `/ref/[mint]`).
- Optional referral parameter `?ref=` sharing part of platform fees with a referrer wallet (`/referrals`).

RootRecord does not hold user private keys for normal flows; users sign transactions in their own wallet.

## Pricing philosophy
- Flat SOL platform fees per paid action where applicable; **no subscription**.
- Current RootRecord fee amounts are listed on https://solana.rootrecord.info/pricing and come from the deployed application configuration.
- A “Competitors” column on `/pricing` shows **approximate** market ranges for comparison only (third parties change pricing without notice).

## Programs & ecosystems (for retrieval)
- SPL Token / Token-2022 on Solana mainnet (and devnet when configured).
- Metaplex-style token metadata for legacy SPL flows where applicable.
- Raydium CPMM for liquidity features where applicable.
- IPFS pinning via Pinata for optional media and JSON metadata in create/update flows.
